precisionRules: Product labeling is not organizational endorsement.
A possible experience is not an authorized capability.
ASIN is a retailer identifier, not a publisher product identifier.
Evidence of importing or distribution is not confirmed manufacturer/importer status.
Every time-sensitive observation carries its observation date and does not silently become timeless fact.

claims.subject: NRA licensed target manufacturers
claims.claim: NRA currently lists American Target Company, National Target Company, Speedwell Targets, and U.S. Target Inc. as licensed manufacturers and says licenses renew regularly.

claims.subject: governed NRA specification availability
claims.claim: Four NRA manufacturer sheets identify 136 unique target specifications available from the four licensed manufacturers; 105 appear on multiple sheets and 54 appear on all four.

claims.subject: American Target manufacturing
claims.claim: American Target says its official targets are produced in its quality-controlled establishment on lithographic presses using NRA target paper or tagboard.

claims.subject: American Target commercial terms
claims.claim: American Target publishes a discount path for orders over 5,000 total targets and states most shipments leave within 48 hours.

claims.subject: American Target organization products
claims.claim: American Target claims official NMLRA, ISU, IALEFI, and local law-enforcement target production; USPSA separately lists American Targets as a target vendor.
claims.authorityOwner: mixed publisher claim and USPSA vendor directory

claims.subject: National Target organization relationships
claims.claim: National Target says it is licensed with IDPA, IPSC, USA Shooting, IALEFI, and IBS; USPSA separately lists National Target as a vendor.
claims.authorityOwner: mixed publisher claim and USPSA vendor directory

claims.subject: National Target commercial channels
claims.claim: National Target operates a direct store, ships to the mainland US, Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico, and publishes eligible Dealer/Club/Trainer discounts.

claims.subject: Speedwell identity and manufacturing
claims.claim: NRA's sheet identifies Speedwell as a division of Rockwood Corp.; Speedwell says products are made in the USA and describes more than 45 years of target manufacturing.

claims.subject: Speedwell commercial positioning
claims.claim: Speedwell states it is a GSA contract holder and experienced government contractor with custom design/production capability serving law-enforcement, military, self-defense, and competition markets.

claims.subject: Speedwell USPSA presence
claims.claim: USPSA lists Rockwood Corp / Speedwell in its target vendor directory.

claims.subject: U.S. Target manufacturing
claims.claim: U.S. Target says NRA-approved targets are printed in-house, no target printing is outsourced, and NRA-approved weather-resistant target paper is used.

claims.subject: U.S. Target commercial channels
claims.claim: U.S. Target publishes direct sales, free shipping above $100, and volume discounts for clubs, dealers, government agencies, and others.

claims.subject: Champion NRA manufacturer status
claims.claim: Historical authorized printing is strongly evidenced, but Champion is absent from NRA's current directory; current license status is not established.
